articles.title: Exceptional assays show why high-grade core stands to super-charge early production profile at FireFly’s Green Bay
articles.summary: Recent drilling operations have delivered exceptional results, significantly extending a high-grade core zone and confirming strong continuity of mineralisation. These findings are crucial for future resource development, highlighting successful exploration efforts. The impressive strength and consistency of these results indicate a promising future for the project, suggesting significant potential value from these geological discoveries.

articles.title: The 5 Types of Aliens People Most Frequently Say They See
articles.summary: A 2026 CBS poll reveals a significant portion of Americans believe in extraterrestrial visitation. The survey indicates one in five Americans are convinced aliens have already visited Earth. This highlights a notable societal perception regarding alien presence, reflecting public opinion rather than scientific consensus, and remains a recurring topic in national discourse.
